description: A PHP class implementing a customer report controller for Opencart's admin interface, including methods for displaying, saving, and generating customer reports with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer reports in the Opencart admin panel, including methods for rendering the report page, saving report settings, and fetching report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and displays the customer report configuration page, setting up breadcrumb navigation and loading necessary views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and saves configuration settings for the customer report, returning success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer report data with filtering options and groups, rendering via view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer report list, primarily invoking getReport to output the report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Builds and returns the customer report data in view format, handling filters, pagination, and fetching data from the model.
